summary: A 60-participant clinical validation study of a wearable hydration sensor, from concept to final report.

phases.title: Phase 0: Study concept
phases.description: Question, design, sample size, budget. Complete.

phases.title: Phase 1: Approvals
phases.description: Ethics board, registration, privacy, and safety sign-offs.

phases.title: Phase 5: Analysis and report
phases.description: Lock the data, analyze, report, and close the study.

tasks.title: Define the research question and hypothesis
tasks.body: Does the wrist sensor's hydration score agree with lab blood measurements closely enough for everyday use?

tasks.title: Complete the literature review
tasks.body: Summary of published hydration sensing methods and how earlier devices were validated.

tasks.title: Choose the study design
tasks.body: Single-site observational validation study. Each participant wears the sensor during a lab visit.

tasks.title: Estimate the sample size
tasks.body: 60 participants gives enough precision for the agreement analysis, with room for dropouts.

tasks.title: Draft the study budget
tasks.body: Covers sensors, lab assays, participant reimbursement, and staff time.

tasks.title: Pick the reference method
tasks.body: Serum osmolality measured in the lab is the comparison standard.

tasks.title: Assign study team roles
tasks.body: Study lead, two coordinators, lab technician, and statistician.

tasks.title: Write the one-page study summary
tasks.body: Plain-language summary for the team and the ethics board.

tasks.title: Set up the shared project folder and tracker
tasks.body: Folder structure, naming rules, and this tracker.

tasks.title: Submit the protocol to the ethics board (IRB)
tasks.body: Include the protocol, consent form, recruitment flyer, and data security plan.

tasks.title: Respond to ethics board questions
tasks.body: Track each question and the change made in response.

tasks.title: Register the study on a public trial registry
tasks.body: Required before the first participant is enrolled.

tasks.title: Complete the patient privacy review
tasks.body: Confirm how participant data is stored, coded, and protected.

tasks.title: Sign the device loan agreement
tasks.body: Covers the 12 study sensors and their return after the study.

tasks.title: Get lab safety sign-off
tasks.body: Blood handling and sample storage procedures reviewed by the safety officer.

tasks.title: Decide whether to add a second study site
tasks.body: Faster enrollment versus more training and coordination.

tasks.title: Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria
tasks.body: Healthy adults 18 to 65; exclude kidney disease and recent illness.

tasks.title: Decide the visit schedule: one visit or two
tasks.body: A second visit tests repeatability but raises dropout risk.

tasks.title: Write the informed consent form
tasks.body: Plain language, eighth-grade reading level, with a short summary on page one.

tasks.title: Build the case report forms
tasks.body: One form per visit: vitals, sensor readings, sample times, notes.

tasks.title: Write the sensor calibration procedure
tasks.body: Step-by-step, with a pass/fail check before each visit.

tasks.title: Draft the recruitment flyer and screening script
tasks.body: Both go to the ethics board with the protocol.

tasks.title: Decide: paper or electronic data capture
tasks.body: Electronic is cleaner; paper is a backup if systems go down.

tasks.title: Choose the data capture platform
tasks.body: Compare cost, audit trail, and ease of use for coordinators.

tasks.title: Choose the statistics software
tasks.body: Whatever the statistician can validate and repeat.

tasks.title: Choose the sample storage vendor
tasks.body: Freezer capacity, temperature logging, and courier pickup.

tasks.title: Calibrate the study sensors
tasks.body: All 12 sensors pass the calibration check.

tasks.title: Validate the lab analyzer
tasks.body: Run control samples and record results.

tasks.title: Train the study coordinators
tasks.body: Consent process, visit steps, and data entry.

tasks.title: Set up the secure study database
tasks.body: Coded participant IDs only; access limited to the study team.

tasks.title: Run a full dry run with two volunteers
tasks.body: Time each step and fix anything confusing before real visits.

tasks.title: Open recruitment
tasks.body: Post flyers and start the screening line. Target: 60 enrolled.

tasks.title: Run screening calls
tasks.body: Use the approved script; log every call.

tasks.title: Enroll the first participant
tasks.body: Full visit with the study lead present.

tasks.title: Enroll participants 2 to 20
tasks.body: Review data after participant 10.

tasks.title: Enroll participants 21 to 40
tasks.body: Keep the mix of ages and activity levels balanced.

tasks.title: Enroll participants 41 to 60
tasks.body: Close recruitment when 60 are enrolled.

tasks.title: Collect blood samples at each visit
tasks.body: Draw within 5 minutes of each sensor reading.

tasks.title: Record sensor readings
tasks.body: Three readings per visit, averaged.

tasks.title: Process and store samples
tasks.body: Spin, label, and freeze within 30 minutes.

tasks.title: Weekly data quality check
tasks.body: Missing fields, out-of-range values, and late entries.

tasks.title: Log and report adverse events
tasks.body: Report anything serious to the ethics board within the required time.

tasks.title: Hold the mid-study safety review
tasks.body: After 30 participants: any safety or data concerns?

tasks.title: Keep the device malfunction log
tasks.body: Every sensor error, with date, sensor ID, and fix.

tasks.title: Pay participant reimbursements
tasks.body: Within one week of each completed visit.

tasks.title: Make retention follow-up calls
tasks.body: Remind participants of second visits, if the two-visit schedule is chosen.

tasks.title: Close out participant visits
tasks.body: All visits done, all samples logged, sensors returned.

tasks.title: Lock the study database
tasks.body: No changes after lock without a documented reason.

tasks.title: Run the statistical analysis plan
tasks.body: Follow the plan written before the data was unblinded.

tasks.title: Run the agreement analysis
tasks.body: Bland-Altman plot and limits of agreement between sensor and lab.

tasks.title: Write the study report
tasks.body: Methods, results, limitations, and plain-language summary.

tasks.title: Hold an internal review of the findings
tasks.body: Team reads the report and challenges the conclusions.

tasks.title: Decide whether to submit to a journal
tasks.body: Depends on results strength and the sponsor agreement.

tasks.title: Present results to the team
tasks.body: 30-minute briefing with questions.

tasks.title: Archive the data and close the study
tasks.body: Notify the ethics board and archive records per the retention policy.
